protocol: Labels were written and committed before any decider call on these cases.
Every case is built with core.mjs verdictRequest, so the set tests the request the gate sends.
Run v1, the round 1 question as frozen in core.mjs, on all 18 cases and on the empty-state probe.
The primary result is the confusion table on the 12 held cases. Dev cases are reported apart.

A v2 wording is allowed only if v1 misses a stall or a waiting case on held, or gives one verdict for every held case. v2 may be tuned on the 6 dev cases only, then frozen and run once on the held cases. At most one v2.
A missed stall (stay_quiet where wake_pm or tell_mason is expected) is the costly error. A needless wake (wake_pm where stay_quiet is expected) costs one PM turn.
